gaps: Breath one assumed a live load behind every form and asked only for the carrier and whether the form conserves or spends. Sorting the kept items by that question showed the fate is not fixed by the form: Second self spends until its bill makes it a vessel, Fear with a ledger holds one fear until dependents make it a generator, and Timing from the volatile house was admitted as vigilance holding the load when the house it holds it against is gone. Three items also refused the only test the map has (remove the form and see what returns) because the form cannot be removed. Both became the changed question for breath two: what the form does with the load, spend, hold, grow, move, or outlive it, and how one could tell.
accepted: Beat: a continuous load nobody could carry whole is cut into units each of which can be, and the cut is kept by a pulse, as the shanty turns a haul that would not end into a hundred pulls that each do, a monthly payment turns an unpayable sum into a payable one, and the prisoner counts days rather than the sentence; carried by the period rather than by any strength, and the form has a life of its own, since the song is sung ashore; it spends the load one unit at a time, and the load returns whole only if the pulse stops before the haul is done.

Gallows round: a joke is built ahead of the moment and passed around a crew, so that when the load arrives it lands in a container two or ten can hold at once, as night nurses and bomb-disposal teams keep a stock of lines that outsiders find monstrous; carried by the joke's being shared rather than by its being funny, and the form has a shape of its own, since the lines are kept and taught to new hands; it spends what the crew can laugh off together and returns the remainder to each member alone, which is why the round is loudest on the wards with the most to hold; not the timing of the volatile house, which is one person's skill, and not the funeral laugh, which is overflow with nothing built for it.

Bill on release: the body keeps the account while the load is on, because settling it would cost the person the hours they need, and presents it the day the load lifts, as the migraine that arrives the morning after the deadline, the fever on the first day of the holiday, the shaking that begins only once the car has stopped; carried by deferral, and the form is an illness with a calendar; it spends the load in one payment, so what it shows is the cost of the vessel that was holding it, which is why the bill is largest after the longest hold; not the body's no, which comes during the load and lifts with it.

Second self: a character is grown to stand where the load lands so the person does not have to, the ward voice, the stage name, the manager's face, as a shy man keeps a persona who is not shy whom the audience meets while he watches from behind it; carried by the split, and the form is a person other people know; it holds the load rather than spending it, so the bill is paid on the day the persona is set down; not the silence, which hides the load, since the persona is on show.

Fear with a ledger: a fear that would otherwise wander is given a place where it can be satisfied, and there it does the work, checking every column twice, as an accountant raised in a house where mistakes were dangerous is the most exact in the firm and could not tell you why; carried by the fear itself, which is the worker, and the form is a competence others pay for; it holds the load and keeps it working, so the retired accountant counts the change twice at the grocer's, since the fear is in the person and the ledger was only where it was put, and the bullied boy's shoulders are the same worker in a different tissue; not an amulet, where the load rides in an object and comes back whole when the object is lost.

Last acre: when the domain a person can order shrinks, the ordering does not shrink with it, and all of it lands on what is left, as a prisoner's cell is kept with a precision no free house has, a man three years out of work keeps a lawn the neighbors photograph, a woman who has lost the say over her days gets the say over her kitchen; carried by the shrinkage of the domain, and the form is an order out of all proportion to what it orders; it holds the load, and the tell is that the order relaxes when the domain widens, which is how it is told from fear with a ledger, where the exactness follows the person into the new job.

The body's no: where a refusal cannot be said, the body says it in the only tender the household or the army accepts, as a conscript whose leg will not bear him on the morning of the march, a daughter whose stomach will not keep food in the house she may not leave; carried by the list of excuses the setting honors, so that the sickness takes the shape of what is allowed, and the form is an illness with a purpose that no one, least of all the sick, has chosen; it holds the load, since the body recovers when the march is cancelled and relapses when it is set again; described from what the household sees, as a phenomenology and not a cause; not the bill on release, which arrives after the load and does not return with it.

Silence with a shape: the load is held by never being spoken, and the not-speaking acquires a shape everyone in the house can trace, the war that is not mentioned, the brother who is not named, the year with no photographs, as the immigrant who stops speaking the language the loss was in; carried by the closed channel, and the form is a topic with edges the household walks around without being told where they are; it holds the load for many in one person, so that when the silence is broken the load does not return to the silent one but lands on the hearers; not the anecdote, which is the same event spent by telling.

Grudge battery: the load is given a name and a face and stored as a wrong done by someone, which turns a weight into a charge that can be kept indefinitely and drawn on, as the prisoner who lives fifteen years on the plan for the man who informed; carried by the personification, and the form is an enemy; it holds the load and grows it, since a charge is topped up by every rehearsal, and it is spent only by revenge, after which the one who won the suit or the duel commonly collapses, since the store that was keeping them up is empty; not the vow, which cannot share a house with a wrongdoer.

Shop that dreads: the load is turned into output, and the output acquires dependents, so that the form which took the pressure begins to manufacture it, as the immigrant's dread becomes a restaurant and the restaurant becomes a payroll, a lease, and a Friday it cannot miss; carried first by the deadline's conversion of dread into units and then by the units' dependents, and the form is an institution with a hunger of its own; it grows the load, since stopping returns the pressure with interest and in the names of the staff; not the ledger, which holds one person's fear in one person's hands.

Downhill delivery: the load is handed by an act to someone with less standing, as a sergeant who has taken the colonel's weather gives it to the private, the manager's dread arrives in the team as a schedule, the beaten child kicks the dog; carried by the status gradient, and the form is a cruelty that seems to belong to the deliverer's character; it moves the load without spending it, and it works, which is why it is stable, since the deliverer is lighter and the receiver has a gradient of their own below; not the lightning rod, which needs no act.

Cornered generosity: what is about to be taken is given away first, so that a loss becomes a gift, as the bankrupt buys the whole bar a round, the dying give away the furniture, the potlatch host burns what a rival would otherwise outbid; carried by authorship, since a thing given is a thing one had the say over, and the form is a largesse strangers admire; it moves the load into obligation, since a gift makes a debtor where a seizure would have made only a loss, so the cornered giver ends the night poorer and owed; not a spender in this map's sense, though it spends money, since the load is now held by the people it was given to.

Timing from the volatile house: a child of a dangerous parent learns to read a room's temperature in half a second and to land the line that breaks the tension before the tension breaks something, and the skill outlives the house as comic timing, as the comedian who can feel a room turn and knows to the syllable when the joke must arrive; carried by the anticipatory reading, and the form is a skill strangers pay for without knowing what it was for; it holds the load as vigilance, since the reading never switches off; not the gallows round, which is a crew's shared container.

residue.item: Wrong valve: the load exits through whichever channel is open regardless of fit, the laugh at the funeral, the rage at the spilled milk.
residue.why: Rejected as a nonmember: nothing on the far side has a shape of its own, so it is release rather than transmutation; kept as the map's boundary case and named in Gallows round's discriminator.

residue.item: Built against it: the bullied boy grows the shoulders the bully made necessary, and the body is kept up as a vessel.
residue.why: Merged into Fear with a ledger: the same fear working in muscle rather than in columns, with the same fate (the competence outlives the house because the worker is inside); its case survives in the ledger item.

residue.item: Load in an object: the load is handed to a thing that can be carried, the checklist, the rosary, the lucky shirt, and the person is calm while the thing is present.
residue.why: Merged into Fear with a ledger's discriminator as the amulet: what it adds is the removal result (lose the object and the load returns whole), which is exactly the ledger's contrast, and it earned no separate carrier.

residue.item: Skill from scarcity: necessity's repetition makes the immigrant's languages and the poor child's arithmetic of the bill.
residue.why: Rejected: 'practice under necessity' is a theme without a specific carrier, and every case it offers is a competence trained by pressure rather than a form the pressure became; Timing from the volatile house keeps the one skill whose carrier is specific.

residue.item: Appetite: the load becomes a hunger for sweets, drink, or sleep.
residue.why: Rejected: an entry from the clinical list the brief bars, with no shape of its own on the far side and no carrier beyond the naming of a craving.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: Authored phenomenology, not a clinical taxonomy: no item is a diagnosis or a claim about cause, and the two illness items describe what the person and the household can see, a calendar and a shape, not an etiology.

The fate assigned to each form (spend, hold, grow, move, outlive) is an authored reading of the typical case, not a property of the form; the edges show forms changing fate, and the itinerary is not a scale of severity or an order a person passes through.

The only test the map offers, remove the form and see what comes back, cannot be run on some forms (a body, a skill), is itself a load, and a form removed from its pressure may go and find more; so the conserve-or-spend question is answered here as a set of tells, not a measurement.

The hydraulic language (load, vessel, spend, charge) is a figure kept for what it lets one notice; no claim is made that pressure is a conserved quantity, and Downhill delivery and Lightning rod describe conservation within a household or a crew only as what an observer of that group sees.

Illustrative cases (the comedian, the accountant, the sergeant, the shanty, the potlatch, the demoted surgeon) are simplified composites exposing one carrier each, not claims about specific persons or histories; forms adopted deliberately as technique are outside except where the chosen form later acquires the mechanism.

gaps: The changed question yielded a form with nothing behind it (Tin of string), a form that goes and buys its load back (Hunting the fuel), a spender by retelling that pairs with the silence (Anecdote that wears smooth), a transfer by structure with no author (Lightning rod), and a loss redescribed as chosen that cannot share a house with a grudge (Vow that was a verdict). Timing from the volatile house was rewritten from a vessel to a fossil resupplied on stage, and Second self gained the clause that a persona kept long enough is held against its own bill. The slug and title stand; the of-sentence now names the fate and the tell rather than conserve-or-spend, and the seriation walks the fates with Bill on release → Second self as the hinge.
accepted: Tin of string: a rule made under a load is kept when the load is gone, as the grandmother who lived through the hunger years keeps a tin of string too short to use, the newly rich founder who still cannot leave food on a plate, the demobbed man who cannot sit with his back to a door; carried by the rule's having been learned as a rule rather than as a response, and the form is a habit with nothing behind it; it outlives the load, so removing the form returns nothing, which is the one test this map has for telling a fossil from a vessel: throw the tin out, and if nothing comes back it was a tin; not fear with a ledger, where the fear is still working.

Hunting the fuel: a form built under load runs only under load, so when the load lifts the person goes and finds some, as the writer who cannot write without a deadline makes one and then misses it, the discharged soldier who takes the night shift on the locked ward, the retired negotiator who picks fights with the parish council; carried by the form's operating condition rather than by any craving for the pressure, and the form is a life arranged around resupply; it grows the load by recruiting it, and the tell is that the form runs at full quality under a manufactured pressure, which is how it is told from a broken form.

Anecdote that wears smooth: the thing that happened is told, and each telling files an edge until the story has a shape that can be told by someone who was not there, as the veteran's night under fire becomes, by the fortieth telling, a dinner story with a laugh in it; carried by the retelling, and the load is spent in the filing, since a story that has become about a character is no longer about the teller; not the silence, which is the same event held by never being told, and the tell that this one is spent is that the teller can now be interrupted.

Lightning rod: a group's load lands on one member without anyone delivering it, because the structure routes it there, as a marriage's strain appears in one child's body and not the other's, a platoon's fear settles on the one everyone rides, the department's dread collects on the new hire; carried by the structure, the least-defended place, and the form is a role, the sick one, the clown, the problem; it moves the load and keeps it moved, so that a rod removed is replaced within the season, and the household that loses its sick child finds another; not downhill delivery, which is an act with an author.

Vow that was a verdict: a loss that was imposed is redescribed as chosen and then kept as a rule, so that it is lived as a value rather than suffered as a sentence, as the surgeon demoted to orderly on arrival becomes the most devout man in the parish, and the woman who was not married takes up a celibacy she then honors; carried by the redescription, and the form is a discipline that is actually kept and does real work; it holds the load, and the tell is that the loss returns as loss the day the doctrine is doubted; not piety as such, since what is transmuted is the authorship of the loss.

residue.item: Deposit with an addressee: the load is told to one who cannot be loaded by it, a god, a diary, the hours of a monastery, and the vessel never fills because its capacity is stipulated.
residue.why: Held, not admitted: the addressee's incapacity to be loaded is stipulated rather than shown, so as written it is a vessel by stipulation; it needs a case where the incapacity is the operative carrier, and Silence with a shape already holds the no-addressee side. Best unresolved seed of the map.

residue.item: Set in the bone: the stoop of the long-unemployed, the clenched jaw, a posture strangers read.
residue.why: Rejected: a record of the load rather than a form with a shape of its own, the pressure's handwriting, which is a witness and not a transmutation; that the removal test cannot be run on a body is kept as a limit.

residue.item: Last chip: the cornered person converts the load into a bet with the last thing they have.
residue.why: Rejected: variance-seeking is a move, not a form, and what is sound in it, the authorship of the loss, is already Cornered generosity's carrier.

residue.item: Pressure prosthesis: the person is addicted to the pressure the form was built under.
residue.why: Merged into Hunting the fuel with the craving removed: the distinction that earns the item is the form's operating condition, not a taste for pressure, and the tell (full quality under a manufactured load) is what separates it from a broken form.

neighbors.separating_case: An accountant three years out of work keeps immaculate household books. Give him the domain back with a job: under Last acre the household books relax as the domain widens, because the ordering was the whole person's ordering landing on the one acre left; under Fear with a ledger the exactness continues at the job and at home alike, because the fear is the worker and the acre was incidental. Same books, and the widening of the domain separates them, which is why the acre's tell is the relaxation and the ledger's tell is the grocer's change.

checks.boundary_case: The wrong valve is out: the laugh at the funeral, the tears at the desk, the rage at the spilled milk, where the load exits through whichever channel is open and in its own shape. Nothing has a shape of its own on the far side, so it is release, not transmutation. Gallows round is in on exactly that contrast, since the joke was built before the moment and can be held by two, and the map's edge from Silence with a shape says that a broken silence with no round on the far side gets the wrong valve.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a loop the walk conceals: Bill on release → Second self, where the spender that is the vessel's cost is what makes the vessel permanent, so the two halves of the itinerary are one household on one morning. It shows two passages between levels: Fear with a ledger → Shop that dreads, where a trait acquires dependents and becomes an institution, and Silence with a shape → Gallows round, where one person's held load lands on a group and needs a group's container; these add to passages-between-levels the carrier by which a person's load becomes a group's. It shows an incompatibility between neighbors on the walk, Vow that was a verdict and Grudge battery, which cannot hold the same load, since a charged loss cannot be a chosen one. It shows a fork at every receiver, Downhill delivery → Lightning rod, where an act becomes a role if the gradient stays and a chain if it does not. And it shows a reversal of the map's own test, Timing from the volatile house → Hunting the fuel, where a fossil resupplied becomes a generator, so that removing the form is not a one-way probe.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read only. Each admitted item names a distinct carrier and a distinct fate, and the strange members (a skill that is a fossil until a room feeds it, a generosity that buys a debtor, a body that files a refusal in the household's own tender, a rule with nothing behind it that is the map's only instrument) are kept as mechanisms rather than softened into advice about coping.

next_crossfield_opening: The removal test as an instrument: connect Tin of string with fertile-forgettings (what an erasure leaves standing) and self-trust-repairs' Move ban (a form removed on purpose), and ask whether a form that returns nothing when removed was ever a transmutation or only a record; and connect Hunting the fuel with forms-of-return, since a person who goes back to the hostile room is returning to a load, and ask where the sameness that licenses that return is kept.

gaps: The map's one instrument, remove the form and see what comes back, was drawn by assertion in the two items that draw the fossil/vessel line: Tin of string's demobbed man fails the item's own test (seat him with his back to the door and dread returns, so he is the ledger's worker in another tissue), and Timing from the volatile house had no tell separating a sleeping reading from vigilance, the one place on the walk with no tell. Second order: the potlatch host has nothing taken and the writer's self-set deadline is manufacture failing, listed as success; Bill on release stated a purposive cause against the declared register; the of-sentence never stated the criterion the items honor, that removal returning the load unchanged is parking, not transmutation. The walk, the hinge, and all seven edges survived.
accepted: Tin of string: a rule made under a load is kept when the load is gone, as the grandmother who lived through the hunger years keeps a tin of string too short to use, the newly rich founder who still cannot leave food on a plate, the professor who still rinses and dries the plastic bags of a stipend spent thirty years ago; carried by the rule's having been learned as a rule rather than as a response, and the form is a habit with nothing behind it; it outlives the load, so removing the form returns nothing, which is the one test this map has for telling a fossil from a vessel: throw the tin out, and if nothing comes back it was a tin, and if dread comes back it never was, which is where the demobbed man who cannot sit with his back to a door belongs, since the door is still doing the fear's work; not fear with a ledger, where the fear is still working, and not an obsolete power still obeyed, which is the same habit seen from the rule's side, where this sees it from the load's, by what removal returns.

Timing from the volatile house: a child of a dangerous parent learns to read a room's temperature in half a second and to land the line that breaks the tension before the tension breaks something, and the skill outlives the house as comic timing, as the comedian who can feel a room turn and knows to the syllable when the joke must arrive; carried by the anticipatory reading, and the form is a skill strangers pay for without knowing what it was for; it neither spends nor holds the load, since the house is gone, and is a fossil in the kitchen until a room supplies danger again, as the hostile club does, where it becomes a form that hunts its fuel; the tell that it is a fossil and not the ledger's worker in another tissue is the quiet room: if the reading runs where nothing is at stake, a dinner among friends scanned every half second, the fear is still the worker and this is a ledger, and only where the reading sleeps until a room turns is the skill a fossil; not the gallows round, which is a crew's shared container.

Bill on release: the body keeps the account while the load is on, as if settling it would cost the person the hours they need, and presents it the day the load lifts, as the migraine that arrives the morning after the deadline, the fever on the first day of the holiday, the shaking that begins only once the car has stopped; carried by deferral, and the form is an illness with a calendar; it spends the load in one payment, so what it shows is the cost of the vessel that was holding it, and the map's reading, not a measurement, is that the bill is largest after the longest hold; not the body's no, which comes during the load and lifts with it.

Cornered generosity: what is about to be taken is given away first, so that a loss becomes a gift, as the bankrupt buys the whole bar a round, the dying give away the furniture, the tenant gives the neighbours the good chairs the week before the bailiff's van; carried by authorship, since a thing given is a thing one had the say over, and the form is a largesse strangers admire; it moves the load into obligation, since a gift makes a debtor where a seizure would have made only a loss, so the cornered giver ends the night poorer and owed; not a spender in this map's sense, though it spends money, since the load is now held by the people it was given to.

Hunting the fuel: a form built under load runs only under load, so when the load lifts the person goes and finds some, as the writer who cannot write without a deadline, for whom a self-set date does not count, takes a commission he does not want for the date that comes with it, the discharged soldier who takes the night shift on the locked ward, the retired negotiator who picks fights with the parish council; carried by the form's operating condition rather than by any craving for the pressure, and the form is a life arranged around resupply; it grows the load by recruiting it, and the tell is that the form runs at full quality under a manufactured pressure, provided the manufacture carries a cost the person cannot waive, which is how it is told from a broken form.
limits: A form whose removal returns the load whole and unchanged (the amulet, the widower's overtime) is parking rather than transmutation and is out; the map has no item for that parked state from which Shop that dreads and Hunting the fuel grow.
seed: The parked load. The boundary case (the widower's overtime) is a load held in hours and returned unchanged, which the map excludes as parking rather than transmutation; but parking is the state from which two of the map's growers begin, since the hours acquire dependents (Shop that dreads) or the person cannot stop when the hours end (Hunting the fuel). The map has no item for the pre-form and no edge from it, and the question it points at is which carriers turn a parked load into a form with a shape of its own, and at what point the removal test flips from returning the load whole to returning it changed. The author's held candidate, Deposit with an addressee, is the same question from the other side: a vessel whose capacity is stipulated is parking that never becomes a form.
